narrative_moments.summary: The Joker crashes the mob syndicate meeting, kills Gambol's thug with a pencil trick, and offers to assassinate Batman for half their fortune.
source_elements_verbatim: [EP02_EL086 | 05:19.40-05:26.00] **GAMBOL:** Give me one reason I shouldn't have my boy here pull your head off. The Joker pulls out a freshly sharpened pencil.
[EP02_EL087 | 05:26.00-05:30.80] **THE JOKER:** How about a magic trick? The Joker SLAMS the pencil into the table, leaving it UPRIGHT.

His BODYGUARD MOVES at the Joker- who SIDESTEPS- GRIPS his head- SLAMS it, FACE DOWN, onto the table... The Bodyguard goes LIMP and slides off of the table.  The PENCIL is gone.  MAGIC.  The Joker BOWS.  Grins at Gambol.
[EP02_EL089 | 05:44.60-05:50.90] **THE JOKER (CONT'D):** And by the way, the suit wasn't cheap.  You should know.  You bought it. Gambol STANDS, furious.  The Chechen stops him.
[EP02_EL090 | 05:50.90-05:54.20] **CHECHEN:** Sit.  I wanna hear proposition. The Joker nods his thanks.  Rises.
[EP02_EL091 | 05:54.20-06:01.70] **THE JOKER:** A year ago these cops and lawyers wouldn't dare cross any of you.  What happened?  Did your balls drop off? See, a guy like me-
[EP02_EL092 | 06:01.70-06:04.40] **GAMBOL:** A freak. Laughs.  Which the Joker tries to ignore.

[EP02_EL093 | 06:04.40-06:23.30] **THE JOKER:** A guy like me... I know why you're holding your little group therapy session in broad daylight.  I know why you're afraid to go out at night. Batman.  He's shown Gotham your true colors.  And Dent's just the beginning. And as for his so-called plan- Batman has no jurisdiction.  He'll find him and make him squeal. I can tell the squealers every time.
[EP02_EL094 | 06:23.30-06:24.30] **CHECHEN:** What you propose?
[EP02_EL095 | 06:24.30-06:26.40] **THE JOKER:** It's simple.  Kill the Batman. Jeers.  Laughter.
[EP02_EL096 | 06:26.40-06:29.40] **MARONI:** If it's so easy why haven't you done it already?
[EP02_EL097 | 06:29.40-06:34.50] **THE JOKER:** Like my mother used to tell me- if you're good at something, never do it for free.
[EP02_EL098 | 06:34.50-06:35.70] **CHECHEN:** How much you want?
[EP02_EL099 | 06:35.70-06:37.50] **THE JOKER:** Half. Laughter.  The Joker shrugs.  Rises.
[EP02_EL100 | 06:37.50-06:43.20] **THE JOKER (CONT'D):** You don't deal with this now, soon Gambol won't even be able to get a nickel for his grandma-
[EP02_EL101 | 06:43.20-06:50.40] **GAMBOL:** Enough from the clown. Gambol gets up, MOVING at the Joker, who casually opens his coat, revealing EXPLOSIVES wired to his chest.  Gambol stops.
[EP02_EL102 | 06:50.40-06:54.60] **THE JOKER:** Let's not blow this out of all proportion. Gambol stares at the Joker.  Hard.

[EP02_EL103 | 06:54.60-07:07.20] **GAMBOL:** You think you can steal from us and just walk away?  I'm putting the word out- 5 hundred grand for this clown dead.  A million alive, so I get to teach him some manners, first. The Joker shrugs.  Turns to the assembled.
[EP02_EL104 | 07:07.20-07:12.00] **THE JOKER:** Let me know when you change your minds. The Joker strolls out.  Maroni turns to Lau.

narrative_moments.summary: Alfred recounts the tale of the Burmese bandit who tossed away rubies, warning Wayne that some men just want to watch the world burn.
source_elements_verbatim: [EP03_EL193 | 15:28.90-15:32.80] **ALFRED:** Respectfully, Master Wayne, perhaps this is a man you don't fully understand, either.

[EP03_EL194 | 15:32.80-15:55.90] **ALFRED:** I was in Burma.  A long time ago.  My friends and I were working for the local government.  They were trying to buy the loyalty of tribal leaders, bribing them with precious stones. But their caravans were being raided in a forest north of Rangoon by a bandit.  We were asked to take care of the problem,  so we started looking for the stones.  But after six months, we couldn't find anyone who had traded with him.
[EP03_EL195 | 15:55.90-15:57.10] **WAYNE:** What were you missing?
[EP03_EL196 | 15:57.10-16:04.00] **ALFRED:** One day I found a child playing with a ruby as big as a tangerine. The bandit had been throwing the stones away.
[EP03_EL197 | 16:04.00-16:05.80] **WAYNE:** So why was he stealing them?

[EP03_EL198 | 16:05.80-16:18.70] **ALFRED:** Because he thought it was good sport. Because some men aren't looking for anything logical, like money... they can't be bought, bullied, reasoned or negotiated with. Some men just want to watch the world burn. Wayne stares at Alfred.  Reaches for the bat-suit.

objects_and_clues.significance: Harvey Dent's decision-making coin which is revealed to have two identical heads until one side is charred in the explosion that kills Rachel.
Calling cards left at murder scenes and hit warnings containing DNA traces of target victims.
Bomb surgically stitched into a henchman's abdomen, detonated by phone to blow MCU holding cells and free Lau.
Letter handed to Alfred stating Rachel chose Harvey Dent over Bruce Wayne, later concealed by Alfred to spare Bruce's hope.
A silver dollar with one scarred side used by Harvey Dent to arbitrarily decide the survival of his targets based on pure chance.
A high-frequency receiver turning every Gotham cell phone into a 3D sonar imaging array to track the Joker, prompting Lucius Fox's resignation.
Triggers supplied to both civilian and prisoner ferries, designed by the Joker to force one vessel to blow up the other.
Rachel Dawes's unsent letter choosing Harvey over Bruce, burned by Alfred to spare Bruce Wayne further anguish.

relationships.relation: Wayne views Dent as Gotham's legitimate savior and hope to retire Batman, while both vie for Rachel's heart.
Diametrically opposed ideological enemies; Batman refuses to kill while the Joker views Batman as the sole force that completes him.
Romantic partners and legal crusade allies whose engagement is severed by the Joker's targeted bombings.
Allied lawmen strained by Gordon's reliance on compromised internal affairs detectives, ending in tragic disillusionment.
Ideological mortal enemies representing incorruptible justice versus nihilistic chaos, trapped in an endless moral duel.
Former prosecutorial allies severed by betrayal and tragedy; Dent blames Gordon's toleration of corrupt officers for Rachel's murder.
Trusted confidants strained by Batman's willingness to cross ethical privacy boundaries to eliminate the Joker.
Symbolic counterparts where Wayne sacrifices his own standing and accepts infamy to keep Dent's heroic public legacy untarnished.

episode_summaries.summary: The Joker orchestrates a ruthless bank heist on the mob's bank while Batman and Lieutenant Gordon join forces with aggressive new District Attorney Harvey Dent to strike at the syndicate's irradiated finances.
As mob accountant Lau flees to Hong Kong with the crime families' fortune, Batman conducts a daring sky-hook extraction, prompting the mob to take the Joker's offer to kill Batman.
Dent levies sweeping RICO indictments against hundreds of gangsters, provoking the Joker to assassinate high-ranking officials and crash Bruce Wayne's penthouse fundraiser in hunt of Dent.
The Joker attempts to assassinate the Mayor, prompting Dent to falsely confess to being Batman, triggering an explosive subterranean armored convoy pursuit.
Gordon captures the Joker in an ambush, but the Joker orchestrates an escape from MCU holding while trapping Dent and Rachel in simultaneous firebombs, killing Rachel and giving birth to Two-Face.
The Joker burns the mob's billions, holds Gotham hostage by threatening city hospitals, and turns a scarred Harvey Dent into a lethal agent of vengeance.
Batman foils the Joker's ferry death traps and rescues hostages, but must take the blame for Two-Face's killing spree to safeguard Gotham's future.
